subject: Important Update: Your Flight Reservation
body: Dear [Name], We are writing to inform you that there has been a change in your upcoming flight reservation. The departure time for your flight has been rescheduled to 2 hours earlier due to unforeseen circumstances. Please review your itinerary and make any necessary adjustments. We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause and appreciate your understanding. If you have any questions or need further assistance, feel free to contact our customer support team. Safe travels, The Airline Team
